cds.title: Oberlin College Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF, Institutional Research & Analytics)

scorecard.title: College Scorecard (location, enrollment, cost; data released 2026-10-15)

stats.notes: Fall 2025 entering class (CDS C1): 11,738 applied (5,400 men, 6,317 women, 21 unknown), 3,873 admitted (1,602 + 2,259 + 12), 768 enrolled (357 + 407 + 4). The residency rows (in-state / out-of-state / international) give 11,732 applicants (793 + 6,924 + 4,015), six fewer than the gender rows; admits (283 + 3,144 + 446 = 3,873) and enrollees (65 + 606 + 97 = 768) match exactly. International: 4,015 applied, 446 admitted, 97 enrolled. The ED figure covers Early Decision (C21: 668 applications, 263 admitted); Oberlin also has a non-restrictive Early Action round whose counts are not in this table. These are institution-wide CDS figures; Oberlin also has a Conservatory with its own audition-based admission, and the CDS does not say how its applicants are split out. The GPA breakdown (average 3.6, 86% reporting) is for all enrolled students. SAT/ACT is optional: 258 enrolled first-years (34%) submitted SAT and 105 (14%) submitted ACT. Undergraduate enrollment (2,998) and the nonresident count (292) are the 'Total Undergraduates' figures from B1/B2; College Scorecard shows 2,887.

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs from the Common Data Set (G1): tuition $70,320, required fees $1,142, on-campus food and housing $20,096 (housing $9,970 + meal plan $10,126), books $930, other expenses $978, per-credit-hour tuition $2,930. G0 asks for 2026-27 costs, and the tuition and fees match the college's 2026-27 page, but the PDF's 'costs not available' tick cannot be read, and the CDS housing and meal figures are below the college's 2026-27 rates (housing $10,270 + meal plan $10,430), so the college's page is used for room and board. CDS H6: 292 degree-seeking nonresidents received institutional aid, average $51,631 (total $15,076,286); the number equals the B2 total of nonresident undergraduates, and the aid year ticked in H1 is unclear in the PDF text.
